source.note: Recorded from a clean checkout of the commit named in head (git status was empty when it was written); ordinary Normal gen-2 (arrivals on) at tick 48000 (day 20), rules 281, saved and continued 120 ticks. One pin for rules 281 alone, the hall repair (src/sim/hall_repair.ts: news passes among those at a hall, a shared meal spot that cannot be stood on becomes the nearest walkable tile, and an evening may be spent at a sound hall near home). It is the same world, tick and continuation length as the rules 278 to 280 pins, written with a copy of their helper (tests/helpers/v281ref.ts), so the pins can be compared digest by digest. Rules 281 adds no saved field, no draw and no feed line; the counts beside the digests are the same kind as the 280 pin's and are of the saved world.
